title: Astronomers found a mysterious object beyond Neptune, and it could be a new dwarf planet
caption:
Astronomers have spotted a potential new neighbor in the far reaches of our solar system. If confirmed, this icy world would be the sixth dwarf planet ever discovered.

Source: Space - Astronomers found a mysterious object beyond Neptune, and it could be a new dwarf planet
